source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: (demonetisation OR demonetization) AND (traders OR vendors OR urban OR informal)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:(demonetisation OR demonetization) AND (traders OR vendors OR urban OR informal),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("demonetisation" OR "demonetization") AND ("informal" OR "traders" OR "urban" OR "vendors"))
